title: Dorothy Vaughan and Learning the Next System
short_teaser: Dorothy Vaughan led human computers at NASA and taught herself and her team programming as electronic computers changed the work.
story: Dorothy Vaughan led human computers at NASA and taught herself and her team programming as electronic computers changed the work. Leadership can mean preparing people for a future that is already arriving. A life story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
